faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the EFL University Tutor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the EFL University Tutor Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Tutor post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Tutor position, candidates must possess an MA in Telugu or a higher degree from a UGC recognized University.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Tutor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Tutor post in the English and Foreign Languages University (EFL University) recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for EFL University Tutor jobs?
faq.answer: The application for the EFL University Tutor positions must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Tutor position at EFL University is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Tutor role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Tutor post at EFL University will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for EFL University Tutor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the EFL University Tutor Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.

faq.answer: The salary for the Tutor position will be as per the UGC guidelines. Specific details regarding the pay scale are usually mentioned in the official notification.
